name: How much does it cost to hire a brain injury personal injury lawyer?
description: Brain injury lawyers usually work on a contingency fee, meaning they receive a percentage of your compensation if they win, with no upfront fees required.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a brain injury personal injury lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most brain injury personal injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you typically don't pay upfront legal fees. Instead, the lawyer's fee is a percentage of the compensation they recover for you, either through a settlement or a court award. If no compensation is recovered, you generally owe no legal fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue their claims without initial financial burden.
